chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-06.proposition: Evolutionary theory cannot demonstrate the absence of intelligent intervention because products of artificial and natural processes may be observationally indistinguishable.

orphanFallback.rationale: The comparisons between artificial and natural products independently establish that observed design-like structure may underdetermine whether intervention occurred.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-07.proposition: Bare consistency with evolutionary biology gives designer hypotheses no evidential support, and unsupported possibilities need not receive epistemic credibility merely because they remain possible.

orphanFallback.rationale: The distinction between consistency and evidence independently states a general evidential standard for assessing designer hypotheses under evolutionary biology.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-09.proposition: Evolution does not require metaphysical indeterminism because deterministic evolutionary models successfully employ pseudorandom mutation and natural selection.

orphanFallback.rationale: Deterministic evolutionary models independently demonstrate that evolutionary randomness need not mean metaphysical indeterminism or genuinely uncaused mutation.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-10.proposition: Showing that an outcome could have an intelligent cause does not show that it did, just as evidence for natural causes can leave murder logically possible without supporting it.

orphanFallback.rationale: The murder-and-accident analogy independently illustrates why the logical possibility of intentional causation carries no evidential implication that it occurred.

chunk-003:c003-01.proposition: Defending Behe's work as science while rejecting naturalism is methodologically unstable because scientific assessment depends on naturalistic inquiry and rebuttal by scientific evidence.

orphanFallback.rationale: The passage independently advances a methodological requirement that purported design research earn scientific standing through ordinary naturalistic testing and criticism.

chunk-003:c003-03.proposition: Naturalism plus evolution need not make cognition unreliable because evolution can produce syntactic systems whose usefulness depends on systematically tracking truth.

orphanFallback.rationale: The calculator and biosphere analogies independently supply a naturalistic mechanism connecting the usefulness of cognitive systems with systematic truth tracking.

chunk-003:c003-04.proposition: Language, representation, approximation, and science permit continued bootstrapping toward cognitive reliability without requiring a divine guarantee of trustworthy faculties.

orphanFallback.rationale: The history of increasingly precise artifacts and concepts independently explains how representational practices can iteratively correct error and improve reliability.

chunk-004:chunk-004-candidate-03.proposition: Evolution can build cognitive systems whose continued adaptive functioning depends on causally tracking relevant truths, just as functional wings must actually enable effective flight.

orphanFallback.rationale: The functional comparison with wings independently explains how selection can favor cognitive mechanisms because their success causally depends on accurate world tracking.

chunk-004:chunk-004-candidate-07.proposition: A predictive natural-scientific explanation of how belief in God arises and persists without being true undercuts any presumption that its prevalence supports its truth.

orphanFallback.rationale: The proposed natural explanation independently supports naturalistic inquiry by showing how religious belief may be explained and predicted without assuming its truth.
